jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Supportability Decisions
jobs.description_text: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. About the team Supportability sits at the vital intersection of platform safety, regulatory trust and merchant growth. Our mission is to ensure legitimate businesses can seamlessly onboard and thrive on Stripe, while proactively safeguarding the financial ecosystem from bad actors and high-risk activity. The Supportability Decisions team is a newly forming pillar anchored in our Dublin office. In this role, you will be the foundational technical lead establishing this capability in Dublin. Our mission is to accelerate Stripe’s global expansion by building the canonical Supportability Decision Layer; a stateful distributed platform that provides unified, real-time, and explainable risk determinations to unlock fast, compliant merchant onboarding and payment method expansion worldwide. Doing this at scale requires solving high-stakes risk challenges with precision. Deceptive merchant activity, such as transaction laundering, introduces significant threats as bad actors actively adapt to mask illicit and unsupported activities behind legitimate storefronts. Rather than relying on rigid, fragmented controls that create unnecessary friction for good users, our team builds the intelligent decision systems that systematically separate legitimate businesses from adversarial behavior, enabling Stripe to grow safely and aggressively. jobs.title: Staff Offensive Security Engineer, Proactive threat
jobs.description_text: About the team The Proactive Threat team finds vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across Stripe's systems, applications, networks, and cloud infrastructure before adversaries do. We're a hybrid offensive function. We run penetration tests, emulate real-world threat actors in red team operations, and work closely with our defensive security teams to validate detection capabilities and improve Stripe's overall security posture. We are builders first. We build custom tooling, automation frameworks, and internal platforms that scale our offensive work and make our assessments repeatable and high-fidelity. Increasingly, that includes AI agents that find and validate vulnerabilities at a scale no human team could reach. We believe the best offensive security engineers are equal parts hacker and engineer. The team is distributed and works regularly with security, engineering, and product stakeholders across Stripe, including teams in Europe and Asia. What you'll do As a Staff Offensive Security Engineer on the Proactive Threat team, you'll set the technical direction for how Stripe tests itself the way a real adversary would. You'll be the team's most senior offensive practitioner. You'll stay deeply hands-on: you'll lead the hardest engagements yourself and write the tooling that makes everyone around you more effective. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Accounting Products
jobs.description_text: About the team Stripe’s Accounting Products team is building modern infrastructure for the Office of the CFO. Our vision is to give finance teams, and the agents that support them, one reconciled and explainable presentation of financial truth. Today, the data and context required to make accounting decisions are fragmented across billing systems, contracts, spreadsheets, general ledgers, and the minds of the people doing the work. Finance teams spend significant time reconstructing what happened, determining the appropriate accounting treatment, reconciling results, and gathering evidence. Giving an agent access to the underlying data is not enough: it also needs the business context, accounting policies, approved judgments, and guardrails required to act reliably. Revenue Recognition is our first major proof point. Stripe has a unique opportunity to help Billing and Metronome users turn complex revenue activity—including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications—into accurate, explainable journal entries. Our ambition is for agents to take on the investigation, configuration, and repetitive work while accountants retain control over consequential judgments and approvals. Over time, we expect to expand into additional Office of the CFO workflows, and we are looking for a Staff Product Manager to help turn this vision into products that finance teams trust. jobs.description_text: About the team Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data. Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points. We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users. At Stripe’s scale—$1.9 trillion in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, processed across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries. jobs.description_text: About the team The Batch Compute Experience team owns the platform that Stripe engineers use to build, run, debug and optimize Apache Spark jobs. Hundreds of engineers and thousands of production jobs driving critical business processes, such as payouts and reconciliations, run on this platform. Our goal is to make Spark at Stripe fast to iterate, reliable by default, and self-optimizing, so engineers can focus on business logic instead of Spark internals. We're doing this through three connected efforts: Modernization : keeping Stripe's Spark runtime and dependency stack current, including Spark 3.5 → Spark 4, Scala 2.13 and Apache Iceberg. These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch. jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job The Associate, CFG Credit is responsible for supporting the underwriting team in document fulfillment from receipt of deal through to the funding stages by acting as a liaison between underwriting, origination, funding and partner/borrower. Working closely with event owners, executives, speakers, Technology Workplace Services, Communications, Facilities, and external vendors, the engineer ensures that every event is rehearsed, technically validated, actively managed, and closed out with appropriate documentation and follow-up.

jobs.title: Bilingual Fraud Officer - Contract Position.
jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job The Fraud Officer conducts investigations to identify, assess, decision and report on activity that indicates an exposure to financial crimes. Ensures potential threats and investigations are evaluated, documented, managed and escalated by following standard operating procedures. Provides subject matter expertise and oversight of criminal risk by following a disciplined and intelligence-based approach to detection and research of activities and events in alignment with EQ Bank’s fraud program and standards to ensure compliance as well as support trending, analysis and insights generation. L’agent ou l’agente, lutte contre la fraude, mène des enquêtes pour cerner et évaluer les activités qui présentent un risque de fraude, prendre des décisions à leur égard et les signaler. Le ou la titulaire veille à ce que les menaces et les enquêtes soient évaluées, documentées, gérées et transmises à un niveau supérieur en suivant des procédures d’exploitation normalisées.

jobs.description_text: The Work As part of a growing and dynamic commercial team, the Commercial Mortgage Analyst is responsible for underwriting annual reviews for CMHC-insured commercial mortgages. jobs.description_text: The Work The Data Scientist, Growth leads the design, development, deployment, and operationalization of advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that support growth, customer experience, and commercial decision-making. The role translates ambiguous business problems into measurable data science solutions, with a focus on pricing, customer engagement, recommendation systems, experimentation, and model-driven decision support. The role works across the full analytical lifecycle, from problem framing and exploratory analysis through model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and production implementation. It also contributes to the modernization, migration, and scaling of machine learning assets and data workflows across cloud platforms and enterprise analytical environments.

jobs.description_text: EQ Bank is changing how Canadians experience banking, and how we serve and protect our customers is central to that mission. As Director, Product Management – Operations & Servicing, you will set the product vision for two critical areas: Care & Servicing (customer care tooling, agentic AI servicing, CRM, and front- and back-office operations) and Risk (fraud and AML systems and controls). You will lead a team of product leaders, owning domain strategy, prioritization, and executive representation while coaching your Leads to deliver measurable outcomes. You will also be the product leader for two of the most significant workstreams in the EQ × PCF integration, customer servicing and fraud/AML. Your work will directly shape how customers are served and protected as the business grows.

jobs.title: Senior AML Advisory Specialist (18 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The AML Advisory team within the Compliance department is a Second Line of Defence function responsible for providing independent oversight, effective challenge and advice to first line business units as a subject matter expert on Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorist Financing (AML/ATF), Sanctions Evasion (SE), and compliance-related matters. This position primarily assists the Senior Manager, AML Advisory, in the ongoing oversight, management and enhancement of Equitable Bank’s enterprise-wide AML/ATF and SE financial crimes program. The Senior Analyst, AML Advisory’s role is a multifaceted one. Responsibilities may include regulatory and policy guidance, risk assessment, change initiative reviews, AML/ATF/SE training and stakeholder engagement, ensuring AML/ATF/SE related policy and procedures are understood, maintained, and current. The role supports oversight and effective challenge to First Line businesses to support a comprehensive and effective Regulatory Compliance Management regime within the Bank and manage financial crimes, reputational and other operational risks. The environment is fast-paced and requires effective time management of multiple tasks and projects.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Commercial QA (12 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Analyst reports to and supports the Senior Manager, Credit Risk, with respect to the management of all aspects of Commercial(Including the Special assets management unit & Specialized finance) credit risk across the Bank. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for reviewing loan portfolios with the objective of maintaining high-quality lending strategies and the monitoring of risk mitigation strategies. A key function of the role is to assist in providing assurance to the Senior Management on the soundness of underwriting processes and account management routines associated with the portfolio. Another key aspect of the role is to assist in the determination of where Equitable may be exposed to credit or other key risks and identify possible mitigating strategies and/or actions that can be implemented to minimize or eliminate the risk. Developing internal relationships with credit stakeholders is critical to the role.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Operational Risk Management

W świecie, w którym media są wszędzie i we wszystkim, łączymy najlepsze platformy, ludzi i partnerów, aby tworzyć nieograniczone możliwości wzrostu. Dołączając do nas korzystasz z programów przygotowujących do zawodów przyszłości oraz pracujesz ze specjalistami, których kompetencje potwierdzone są certyfikatem DIMAQ . W WPP Media nie tylko używamy technologii – my ją tworzymy. Dzięki naszym autorskim narzędziom, takim jak platforma WPP Open (platforma AI dla marketingu), będziesz pracować na międzynarodowych projektach i wspierać klientów na całym świecie. W WPP Media możesz korzystać z globalnych zasobów i kontaktów całej sieci WPP, poszerzać sieć znajomości i uczyć się od najlepszych w marketingu i reklamie. Jako Top Employer Poland & Europe 2021–2025 tworzymy środowisko pracy oparte na zaufaniu i wysokich standardach HR. Po raz drugi z rzędu (2024 i 2025) Magazyn Media & Marketing uhonorował nas tytułem Grupy Mediowej Roku. Więcej informacji możesz znaleźć na stronie wppmedia.com Gdzie będziesz rozwijać swoje kompetencje? Choreograph to globalna część WPP Media, która łączy dane i technologię, aby transformować marketing na całym świecie. Nasz zespół w Polsce to jeden z kluczowych hubów analitycznych w ramach globalnej struktury Choreograph. Tworzymy zespół 40 ekonometryków i ekspertów data science, który stanowi jeden z najwięk

We care for you: Wir übernehmen deine Kosten für die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und du bekommst für jeden Arbeitstag einen 8€ Essensgutschein zur freien Verfügung. Das bewegst du: Als Junior Digital Activation (m/w/d) bist du verantwortlich für die Umsetzung und Steuerung digitaler Kampagnen über alle relevanten Touchpoints – Display, Mobile, Video, Social und SEA – und fungierst dabei als zentrale Ansprechperson für alle digitalen Themen.
